subject: design/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: For installed Forgejo, use the operator-approved trusted-repository model in draft problem P-9: prepare and request review of the exact head, then authorize a lock only from the configured human's latest authenticated review of that head and independently verified merged contents. The operator governs direct/force pushes, privileged merges and path exceptions. Preserve existing GitHub protection and approval behavior. (design-brainstorm:forgejo-feature-draft-tech-design#D-2)
